name: app-oviah-case-study-cover-two-phones-lilac-blobs
title: OVIAH case study cover: two phones over lilac blob shapes with a droplet-O logo
whatItIs: A lavender cover with soft overlapping circle blobs, two phones showing a home screen with a cycle countdown ring and an onboarding welcome screen with a droplet-shaped 'O' logo, and 'OVIAH — Understanding your body. Managing your health.' beside them.
whatItMeans: Calm and reassuring; soft blobs and a droplet logo make a health topic feel gentle rather than clinical.
techniques: Use a droplet or organic shape as a wordmark's first letter.
Show a countdown ring as the home screen's focal metric.
Layer soft overlapping blobs for a calm backdrop.

vocabulary.definition: A circular progress indicator counting down to an event.
A logo shaped like a water drop, often used for health or fluid themes.
